_smoke_note: NOT A RESULT AND NEVER QUOTABLE AS ONE. Tiny atoms (128), tiny hash pool, few hash iterations, gates bypassed. Its only job is to prove the code paths execute: parity guard, corpus, M108-exact whitener + candidates, deterministic dictionary rebuild, ITQ fit, random-projection fit, bit packing, XOR+POPCNT Hamming, triangle + uneven-edge pooling, ridge heads, per-domain eval, binary MAC/op ledger, and both kill switches evaluate. Every accuracy it produces is meaningless.
